name: classify_media
description: Classify an inbound image, document, audio or video and file it in Drive under media/{year}/{month}/{category}/. Call it once per received media item, before answering anything else, passing the path from the [image]/[document]/[voice]/[audio]/[video] marker. Never invent a path and never pick a category yourself: use the category returned by the tool.

path.description: Drive path of the received media, exactly as it appears in the marker, for example inbox/9f3c1a.jpg or inbox/9f3c1a-contrato.pdf

caption.description: Caption or message text the user sent together with the media, empty when the media arrived without text
